message:
Progression milestone 4: serving hatch and conveyor belts

- Serving hatch (level 4): sits in the dividing wall, usable from both
  sides, auto-delivers a matching plate to its customer after 1.5 s
- Conveyor belts (level 6): placeable in either room, point the way you
  face, carry items to the next belt, counters, hatch, sink, rack, or
  serve a matching plate straight onto a table
- Both move, sell, save and sync like other stations; guests see belts
  glide smoothly; Turbo belts upgrade joins the level-up vote
- Version 11.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Progression milestone 3: level-gated shop

- Shop items unlock by level via CONFIG.unlocks (sink/rack L1; counter,
  table, chopping board L2; hob, bin L3); the host refuses locked purchases
- Locked items show their level; the setup panel shows level, XP bar and
  the next unlock; summaries name shop unlocks
- Owned stations can still be moved and sold at any level
- Version 10.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Progression milestone 2: toppings, menu board, XP and levels

- Orders are base dish + toppings (lettuce/tomato from level 2), shown as
  icons; plates must match exactly; toppings add to the price
- Menu board in kitchen setup: host switches unlocked dishes on/off, guests
  suggest; more dishes on = bigger tips
- Restaurant XP (speed-scaled, toppings, VIP, no-walkout and great-day
  bonuses) and levels; summary shows XP bar, level-up and next unlock
- Upgrade vote only on level-up days; salad burger replaced by toppings,
  salad unlocks at level 8, New dish upgrade removed; save version 2
- Fix: solo games now keep a refresh copy (resume after refresh)
- Version 9.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Progression milestone 1: saves, checkpoints and save codes

- serialiseState()/loadState() with saveVersion and migrations; bad or old
  saves fall back to defaults, newer saves are refused
- Auto-save at the start of every day; checkpoint every 3 days
- Closing down (0 stars) restores the last checkpoint: 'Back to Day N'
- Copy/import save codes (deflate + base64, versioned) from the menu or
  summary; guests receive the host's save so anyone can copy it
- New restaurant option with confirmation; version 8.0

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Show the game version on the menu and warn on version mismatch

A host and guest on different versions (e.g. one has an old cached copy)
are now told to refresh instead of playing with mismatched rules.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Milestone 7: kitchen setup with a shop and a layout editor

- New kitchen-setup phase before every day: pick stations up and move them,
  buy hobs, sinks, racks, boards, bins, counters and tables, sell on the bin
- Placement rules keep every station, spawn and the dining room reachable
- Layout travels in snapshots, so guests and refreshed hosts rebuild it exactly
- Start with 20 pounds; score counts money earned; Bulk buyer upgrade replaces
  the second-hob and extra-table upgrades
- Fix: restored players no longer fire a phantom grab
- README: how a day works and free deployment steps

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Milestone 6: sounds, animations, reconnecting, day length option, tuning

- Day length picker in the menu (2-10 min, host's choice applies to the room)
- Synthesised WebAudio sound effects with a mute button (M) and Leave button (Esc)
- Particles (steam, smoke, sparkles, chopped bits, bubbles), item pops, walking bob
- Host refresh brings the room back with the same code; guests auto-rejoin
- Guests retry for ~20s with a banner; a host who leaves tells everyone at once
- Tuning: more customers with more chefs, slightly more forgiving burn time

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Milestone 5: upgrades with voting, random events, losing and best score

- End-of-day upgrade vote (3 random from 11; majority wins, host breaks ties)
- Map-changing upgrades (second hob, extra tables) rebuild identically on clients
- Random events: rush hour, cold hob, VIP, late delivery, fussy customer, inspector
- Run ends at 0 stars; score = days survived x 100 + money; best kept per browser
- Difficulty ramp: patience shrinks each day, more events later on

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Hob Mob: co-op kitchen game (milestones 1-4)

Single-file browser game: kitchen stations, customers and day loop,
PeerJS host-authoritative multiplayer, and phone touch controls.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
